answer: One concrete defense is costly staking: every agent must bond scarce tokens before it can transact, so spawning a sybil swarm drains real capital instead of being free. Picture honest agents as a grove whose roots interlock through mutual attestations, with their bonds pooled in a shared lagoon that gets slashed on fraud. A deceitful clone, marked sable on the reputation ledger, forfeits its deposit, making mass fake identities economically self-defeating.
